no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the safety profile is acceptable for the treatment of partial-onset seizures in patients with epilepsy and because the clinical trial design is similar to that of trials of previously approved drugs for the treatment of partial-onset seizures in patients with epilepsy.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for the Briviact (brivaracetam) NDA (co-bundled application NDA205836/205837/205838). The Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Office/Division Director memo each state the application was not referred to an advisory committee because brivaracetam is structurally related to the long-approved levetiracetam, the development program and endpoints were typical of prior AEDs, and there were no controversial issues given clear efficacy and reasonable safety. With no AdComm held, there are no committee-driven changes to the approval.
